name: Repenance
overview: Scripture commands all people to repent, turning away from ignorance and sin as God now requires (Acts 17:30). True repentance involves heartfelt belief that leads to righteousness and salvation, expressed openly through confession (Romans 10:10). Believers are urged to diligently hold fast to these truths to avoid slipping away from faith (Hebrews 2:1). Additionally, mutual confession and prayer among the righteous are powerful means of spiritual healing and restoration (James 5:16).
